t: Bedrock, Dazzle, and the Packaging Rabbit Hole
s: This technical journal entry details the foundational work of building a robust software development environment, contrasting it with the superficial 'dazzle' of applications. It explores sci-fi influences on technical vision and recounts a deep debugging session involving Python packaging, Nix flakes, and PyPI.
sub: The philosophical influence of science fiction (Asimov, Banks) on technical vision and software development.
Debugging a Python project's importability in Jupyter Notebooks.
The interplay of Nix flakes, Python packaging (pyproject.toml), and PyPI for robust development environments.
The architectural philosophy of building a solid 'bedrock' before creating 'dazzling' applications.
